rust.name: crates/domain/src/declared.rs:64:5: replace slow_limit -> u64 with 0
rust.why: Gate now takes omitted fields from its struct default, and a successful fast landing with a slow-only declaration can leave the default slow timeout unchecked.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/heavy.rs:100:15: delete field lands from struct Job expression in Job<'a>::landing
rust.why: A lone landing can pass without its priority marker, while the model traces supply that marker directly and cannot catch its loss when Rust constructs the job.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/workdir.rs:155:9: replace App::work_dir_asked with ()
rust.why: Successful landing and cleanup can still pass without the request record that lets a later sweep recover a work directory left by an interrupted allocation.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/heavy.rs:200:5: replace outcome -> Option<Outcome> with None
rust.why: A landing can still report success even if its heavy run loses the outcome that the run history should expose.
